record.question: All the following statements in shock are true except
options: Initial stage - cardiac output is decreased, and tissue perfusion is threatened
Compensatory- Almost immediately, the compensatory stage begins as the body's homeostatic mechanisms attempt to maintain cardiac output,blood pressure, and tissue perfusion
Progressive- The compensatory mechanisms begin to meet tissue metabolic needs, and the shock cycle is corrected
Refractory- Shock becomes unresponsive to therapy and is considered irreversible
